set.body: Defer executor integration until the paired fit algebra is stable. Acceptance: propose or implement a PairedMultivarPlan/SupervisedMultivarPlan boundary that does not overload the current single-input ROI-local MultivarPlan; document whether execution supports ROI-by-ROI X with global Y, paired ROI sets, or both.
set.title: Multivar: design paired supervised plan boundary
